The case: The defendant is 何2某臣 (the complainant) who made false statements accusing the township party secretary 杨某 of assault, causing damage to his reputation. He also spread these false statements via TV, internet, and petitions. The court finds he defamed Yang. Also he had a prior injury (bone fracture) from June 1 unrelated. He also possibly committed "诽谤罪" (defamation). In Chinese criminal law, defamation is a crime under "侵犯名誉权罪" (defamation) under Article 246 of Criminal Law (formerly). The charge is "诽谤罪". Also maybe "扰乱公共秩序" but that's administrative. The facts mention he was previously administratively detained for disturbing public order. But the criminal charge is defamation.

Is there any other crime? He also made false accusations to authorities, maybe "伪证罪"? No. He didn't lie in court. He made false statements to media, but that's defamation. He also possibly "敲诈勒索"? He demanded compensation? Not indicated. He just spread false statements.

Thus likely only one charge: 诽谤罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]诽谤<eoa>.
